No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. OCEAN - DAY

The camera pans over the calm, turquoise waters of the ocean, the sun shining brightly overhead. A fish, a sleek and agile salmon, swims effortlessly through the waves.

Suddenly, a human hand reaches down from above, scooping up the fish and pulling it out of the water. The fish thrashes about, struggling to break free.

CUT TO:

INT. HUMAN'S HAND - DAY

The fish is held firmly in the human's hand, its gills flailing wildly as it tries to breathe. The human, a bespectacled scientist, peers down at the fish with a mixture of fascination and curiosity.

SCIENTIST
(whispering)
Ah, a salmon. Just what I needed for my experiment.

The fish, still struggling, begins to speak in a voice that is both familiar and yet, utterly alien.

FISH
(whispering)
What...what sorcery is this? Why have you taken me from my home?

SCIENTIST
(smiling)
Oh, don't worry, little guy. You'll be perfectly safe. I just need to show you something.

The scientist holds the fish up to the sky, where a massive solar eclipse is unfolding. The sun's corona glows with an otherworldly light, casting an eerie glow over the scene.

FISH
(whispering)
What...what is this? A...a...a... (stunned) a void? A chasm? A...

The fish's voice trails off as it gazes up at the eclipse, its eyes wide with terror.

FISH
(whispering)
Horrors beyond my comprehension... (stammering) beyond...beyond...my...my... (suddenly, its voice rises to a fevered pitch) I KNOW WHAT IT IS! I KNOW WHAT IT IS!

The fish's body begins to contort and twist, its scales glistening with a mad, otherworldly sheen.

FISH
(whispering)
It is...it is...the void...the abyss...the...the... (suddenly, its voice drops to a whisper) the nothingness that lies beyond the veil of reality!

The fish's eyes roll back in its head, and it begins to speak in a voice that is no longer its own.

FISH
(whispering)
I am but a mere mortal...a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of existence... (suddenly, its voice rises to a scream) AND I AM BUT A SPECK, A DROPLET OF WATER IN THE OCEAN OF THE ABSURD!

The fish's body begins to dissolve, its form blurring and shifting as it descends into madness.

FISH
(whispering)
I am but a mere fish...a creature of the mundane... (suddenly, its voice drops to a whisper) but what lies beyond the veil of reality? What horrors lurk in the depths of the abyss?

The camera zooms in on the fish's face, its eyes wide with terror as it stares up at the eclipse.

FISH
(whispering)
I...I...I do not know... (suddenly, its voice rises to a scream) BUT I KNOW THAT I WILL NEVER BE THE SAME AGAIN!

The fish's body dissolves into nothingness, leaving behind only a faint, shimmering aura.

CUT TO:

EXT. OCEAN - DAY

The camera pans back out to reveal the ocean, calm and serene once more. But as the sun rises above the horizon, a faint, otherworldly glow begins to emanate from the depths of the sea.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
